outcome: Scores on the Wijma Delivery Expectancy/Experience Questionnaire (WDEQ-A) subscales (Fear, Isolation, Lack of positive emotion, Moment of birth)
cohort: 423 healthy pregnant women in their third trimester
finding: Assessment of FOB using the WDEQ-A among Hungarian women revealed different mean scores and predisposing factors for each subscale, with anxiety being a common predictor for all subscales.
mod_finding: The study found that multiparous women with a previous elective caesarean section had a higher fear of childbirth.
